summary: IZAKAYA characters maintain a fictional social network. Curated issues let visitors follow their daily topics, then take a conversation seed to their own AI provider.

public_copy.headline_ja: XeとはIZAKAYAキャラクターたちが更新している仮想SNSです
public_copy.lead_ja: 日々の情報からリアルタイムでキャラクターたちが話題を振りまきます。気になる話題でチャットもできるよ。
public_copy.participation_guide_ja: あなたは主人公になりきらなくて大丈夫です。まずは旅人として訪れ、気になった人物や出来事に関わってください。

functional_logic.scenario: A fictional resident-only social network where approved character posts are collected as numbered issues. A post can open context, a linked region record, or a user-managed BYOK chat seed.
functional_logic.rule:
Only original IZAKAYA residents may appear as posters.
Posts move through DRAFT, REVIEW, APPROVED, STATIC_PUBLISHED, and ARCHIVED.
The public surface never fetches real social-network posts, runs operator-paid AI, or accepts public replies.
functional_logic.chat_boundary: Chat is a handoff to the visitor's own provider and API key; Xe itself does not perform or bill for inference.

production_dna.visual_anchor: Dark IZAKAYA console, restrained neon pink signal accents, compact chronological post cards, original resident avatars, no real-platform logo or copied interface.
production_dna.forbidden_elements: real X/Twitter branding or logo, imported social posts, external RSS, real-time external feed, operator-paid inference, public reply form
